question: 3 月每个一级类目里 GMV 最高的商品是哪个？
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    p.name AS product_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0)) AS gmv
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE c.parent_id IS NULL
  AND LOWER(o.status) = 'completed'
  AND (
        substr(o.created_at, 1, 7) = '2025-03' 
        OR substr(o.created_at, 1, 7) = '2025/03'
      )
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, p.id, p.name
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0)) = (
    SELECT MAX(gmv)
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            c2.id AS cid,
            SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price - COALESCE(oi2.discount, 0)) AS gmv
        FROM categories c2
        JOIN products p2 ON p2.category_id = c2.id
        JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.id
        JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = oi2.order_id
        WHERE c2.parent_id IS NULL
          AND LOWER(o2.status) = 'completed'
          AND (
                substr(o2.created_at, 1, 7) = '2025-03' 
                OR substr(o2.created_at, 1, 7) = '2025/03'
              )
        GROUP BY c2.id, p2.id
    ) t
    WHERE t.cid = c.id
)
ORDER BY gmv DESC
gold_sql: SELECT category, product FROM (SELECT p1.name AS category, p.name AS product, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p1.id ORDER BY SUM(d.gmv) DESC) AS rn FROM daily_product_metrics d JOIN products p ON d.product_id=p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id=c.id JOIN categories p1 ON c.parent_id=p1.id WHERE d.date LIKE '2025-03%' GROUP BY p1.id, p.id) WHERE rn=1

question: 退款率（退款金额/销售金额）最高的前 3 个卖家是谁？

       SUM(COALESCE(r.amount, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity - oi.discount, 0)), 0) AS refund_rate
